sql: /* Query 8: filter4_agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.position, AVG(city.area) AS avg_city_area FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE manager.age = 76 AND team.founded_year > 1989 AND team.team_name = 'Philadelphia 76ers' GROUP BY player.position

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].

area.description: area is the area of the city in square kilometers (e.g. 89.64).
